name: The Gold Reserve Kitchen & Bar
notes: 2 photos of physical menu boards. 1.jpg shows a GR-branded (Gold Reserve, est.1928) breakfast board plus the edge of a dinner board; 2.jpg shows a separate breakfast/lunch board with no visible restaurant name but the same banking-themed concept (Banker's Breakfast, Vault Burger) and several overlapping dish names at different prices, indicating an older/alternate menu revision of the same restaurant. Dishes with identical names across both photos (Banker's Breakfast, Eggs Benedict, Egg White Frittata, Seasonal Fruit Bowl) were merged, keeping the 1.jpg version. Coffee/tea/juice and Starbucks-service listings were skipped as drinks, not dishes. Descriptions cropped at photo edges were omitted rather than guessed.
